title: Donkey Hooks System
description: Hexagonal middleware hooks for message flow, context injection, and memory capture - agnostic to memory backend
principles: Hooks are a Port (interface), not an Adapter
Any memory backend can be used via SemanticMemoryPort or custom hook
Hooks receive context and return modified context - chain pattern
No hardcoded memory formats - injectable via configuration

stories.title: Hook Port - Core Interfaces
stories.description: Define hook port and types in hexagonal architecture
acceptance: HookPort concept in src/donkey/ports/hook.nim
HookPhase enum: pre_llm, post_llm, pre_tool, post_tool, post_response
HookContext: immutable input context (message, history, userId, sessionId, metadata)
HookResult: either modified context or rejection with error
HookRegistry: manages ordered execution of hooks per phase

stories.title: Hook Executor - Orchestrator Integration
stories.description: Integrate hook execution into orchestrator message flow
acceptance: Hooks execute before LLM call (pre_llm phase)
Hooks execute after LLM response (post_llm phase)
Hooks execute before/after tool calls
HookChain: hooks run in order, each sees output of previous
Short-circuit on rejection - return error to user

stories.title: ContextInjection Hook - Abstract
stories.description: Abstract hook that injects relevant context into messages
acceptance: Hook receives message and userId
Hook queries memory system via injected port
Hook returns enriched context (not modified message - preserves LLM judgment)
Context passed as hint, not directive - LLM decides relevance

stories.title: RAG Context Hook Adapter
stories.description: Example adapter using semantic search for context retrieval
acceptance: Implements HookPort
Uses SemanticMemoryPort.search() for vector retrieval
Returns top-k relevant context entries
Can be enabled/disabled via config
Does NOT hardcode retrieval logic - uses port abstraction

stories.title: MemoryCapture Hook
stories.description: Hook that extracts and persists relevant information to memory
acceptance: Extracts structured data from LLM response (via post_llm)
Writes to memory via injected MemoryPort
Agnostic to memory backend - MdFileAdapter, PostgresAdapter, MAGMA, etc.
Can be configured to capture: facts, decisions, preferences, todos

stories.title: Hook Configuration
stories.description: Configure hooks per phase in donkey.toml
acceptance: Specify hooks per phase: pre_llm_hooks = ["rag_context", "user_prefs"]
Configure hook parameters: rag_context.top_k = 5
Support built-in hooks by name
Support custom hook registry

stories.title: Hook Testing
acceptance: Test hook chaining (order matters)
Test short-circuit on rejection
Test context enrichment flow
Mock memory port for isolated testing
